description: Obtain authorized access to Fain, Ford, and Lyavdansky 2016 and resolve all eleven State Hermitage inventory numbers, texts, translations, and concordances; open metadata currently identifies S-442, S-444, S-446, S-447, and S-448, leaving six objects unresolved.

source.title: Aramaic Incantation Bowls at the State Hermitage Museum, St. Petersburg
source.authors: Tatyana Fain; James Nathan Ford; Alexey Lyavdansky
source.citation: Fain, Tatyana, James Nathan Ford, and Alexey Lyavdansky. ‘Aramaic Incantation Bowls at the State Hermitage Museum, St. Petersburg.’ In Babel und Bibel 9 (Winona Lake: Eisenbrauns, 2016), 283–316.
source.notes: HSE metadata confirms eleven bowls: seven square-script, one Mandaic, and three pseudo-script; direct PDF requires institutional login.
